shared_elements: low relief carving on stone surface
curved band or line across the surface
justification: Both are low-relief carvings that include a disc-like circular motif and curving bands, and both imply human figures, but that is where correspondence ends. A shows a detailed narrative procession of naturalistic bearded men leading horned rams past a stylised tree above a rosette border, while B shows only large, schematic, isolated forms (a ring, lumps, a curved arc) on a broad columnar body with no scene, no animals and no narrative arrangement.
